history.user: I finally posted my entry for the Marlowe Open, the juried ceramics show. Three stoneware bowls with the ash glaze I have been fighting with since winter.
history.assistant: Since winter is a long time to fight a glaze. Sending the bowls off must have felt like letting go of something.

history.user: They say results come by post in the autumn. I have decided not to think about it until then.
history.assistant: Autumn it is, then. Out of your hands for now.

history.user: Sent off the application for the archive assistant post at the county records office this morning. Closing date is Friday.
history.assistant: In before the deadline. That is one thing off the list.

history.user: No word yet from the records office. I keep refreshing my email like it will help.
history.assistant: Refreshing never speeds it up, and somehow we all do it anyway.

steps.text: Spent the evening at the wheel again. First time I have thrown anything decent since I sent those bowls away.
And there was an envelope on the mat when I got in. They finally wrote back.
